description:
## Pet data (`petData`)
Read-only wrapper around the public Petstore demo API. Only findPetsByStatus, getPetById and getInventory are called; there are no mutations, sample pets or fabricated inventory counts. Demo records may change, disappear or contain malformed data; inventory is an independent server snapshot, not derived from the list.

Public methods: `loadPets(status = 'available', force = false)` selects available/pending/sold and resolves a normalized list; `loadInventory(force = false)` resolves reported valid counts; `getPet(id, force = false)` resolves a normalized detail or rejects with code PET_NOT_FOUND/status 404; `clearCache()` invalidates caches and in-flight writes and clears displayed state without cancelling network requests. All loads reject on failure with safe Error objects carrying context/code/status; callers must handle rejections for retry UI. Force bypasses cached values but shares an existing request for the same resource. Status, inventory and detail caches expire after two minutes.

Public state: pets, currentStatus, loading, error and lastUpdated describe only the selected list; inventory/inventoryLoading/inventoryError describe inventory; detailLoading and detailErrors are maps keyed by String(id). Detail failures never erase pets. lastUpdated is the selected list's successful fetch timestamp (epoch milliseconds), not cache-access time. Older selections and pre-clear responses cannot overwrite current state.

Normalized pets expose only id, name, category, status and string tags. Invalid records/IDs are omitted and duplicate list IDs keep the first record. IDs retain their server string or numeric representation; digit strings are never converted to Number, and routes should use String(pet.id). Precision already lost by a server JSON numeric int64 cannot be recovered. Text is plain, length-bounded and stripped of angle brackets/control characters: render using text bindings, never HTML bindings. photoUrls/assets are deliberately omitted; use local icon placeholders. Public state should be treated as read-only by consumers.
name: pet-data

variables.description: Normalized pets for currentStatus. Each record has id (original number/string), name, category string, status and string tags; no remote images.
variables.name: pets

variables.description: Independent server inventory snapshot containing only valid nonnegative integer counts; null until loaded. Missing counts are not invented.
variables.name: inventory

variables.description: Whether the currently selected pet-list request is pending; excludes inventory and detail work.
variables.name: loading

variables.description: Safe message for the selected list's most recent failure, or null. Request promises still reject.
variables.name: error

variables.description: Epoch milliseconds of the selected list's successful network fetch, or null before a successful load.
variables.name: lastUpdated

variables.description: Selected list status: available, pending or sold.
variables.name: currentStatus

variables.description: True only while the inventory request is pending.
variables.name: inventoryLoading

variables.description: Safe inventory-specific failure message, independent of list error.
variables.name: inventoryError

variables.description: Per-ID pending flags keyed by String(id); absent or false means not loading.
variables.name: detailLoading

variables.description: Per-ID safe error messages keyed by String(id), or null after a retry/success. A missing pet rejects with PET_NOT_FOUND and HTTP status 404.
variables.name: detailErrors

variables.description: Private plain-text normalization; never evaluates HTML.
variables.name: safeText

variables.description: Accepts integer numbers or digit strings without numeric conversion, preserving int64 strings.
variables.name: validId
normalizePet
normalizePets
normalizeInventory
makeError

variables.description: Private error mapper: never exposes arbitrary remote error bodies or HTML.
variables.name: requestError

variables.body: return !!entry && Date.now() - entry.time >= 0 && Date.now() - entry.time < this.ttl;
variables.name: fresh

variables.description: Selects status (default available) and returns a promise of normalized pets. Separate two-minute status caches, network deduplication and selection tokens prevent stale overwrites. force defaults false and bypasses cache, not in-flight deduplication. Rejects with safe context pets:<status> errors.
variables.name: loadPets

variables.description: Returns a promise of server-reported inventory counts with a two-minute cache. force defaults false; concurrent requests share network work. Updates only inventory state, and preserves the previous snapshot on failure.
variables.name: loadInventory

variables.description: Returns a promise of a normalized pet detail. Preserves numeric/string ID representation and never converts digit strings to Number. Separate per-ID two-minute cache and request deduplication. force defaults false. Per-ID detailLoading/detailErrors track context; rejects with PET_NOT_FOUND/status 404 for missing pets. Never changes the selected list.
variables.name: getPet

variables.description: Synchronously clears all caches, public snapshots and errors/flags. Invalidates outstanding response writes without cancelling requests; their original callers still receive fulfillment/rejection. Keeps currentStatus selected and makes subsequent calls start fresh.
variables.name: clearCache
